title: Full text on hover, nook split on one line
notes: Wherever a text is cut off (names in lists, long labels, text fields), resting the mouse on it shows the full text — in the plugin windows and in PanelPro Web.
Nooks: the number of pieces and the two split buttons (↔ Side by side, ↕ Over and under) are on one line.
PanelPro Web: the module editor has no Module tab any more for ordinary modules — the name is over the sizes, the inner width is a choice in the width…
